name: Kosovo
famous_for: Historic Ottoman stone bridges in Prizren, Rugova Canyon rock walls, medieval monasteries of Decani, and young coffee culture.
tourists: Approx. 350,000 visitors; famous for Sinan Pasha Mosque, Prizren Fortress overlooking river, and Mirusha waterfalls.
must_know: Kosovo has the youngest population in Europe, with over 50% of its residents under 30 years old, fueling vibrant cafe life.
fun_fact: The Newborn monument in Pristina is repainted with fresh artistic murals every year on Independence Day (February 17).
